description: This file provides utility functions for tenant selection management in a web application, including listing accessible tenants, selecting a tenant, retrieving the active tenant, and clearing the tenant selection. It interacts with backend APIs and manages local storage and cookies.

methods.name: listAccessibleTenants
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of tenants accessible to the current user, trying session endpoint first, then fallback to authorized tenants endpoint.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Persists the selected tenant by posting to backend and stores the active tenant in local storage.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from local storage or cookie fallback.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant
methods.description: Removes the active tenant information from local storage.
